findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "tokenintel_register" references sensitive artifacts (env var, api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tokenintel_register, tokenintel_social_sentiment · Private data: tokenintel_discover, tokenintel_invoke, tokenintel_register, tokenintel_briefing, tokenintel_health_matrix, tokenintel_token_context, tokenintel_realtime_prices, tokenintel_price_candles, tokenintel_whale_flows, tokenintel_social_sentiment, tokenintel_capital_rotation, tokenintel_match_impact_history, tokenintel_match_correlation, tokenintel_goal_direction_asymmetry, tokenintel_event_reaction_profile, tokenintel_match_event_replay, tokenintel_match_odds, tokenintel_dex_depth, tokenintel_dex_liquidity · Public sink: tokenintel_register · Destructive: tokenintel_social_sentiment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tokenintel_register, tokenintel_social_sentiment · Private data: tokenintel_discover, tokenintel_invoke, tokenintel_register, tokenintel_briefing, tokenintel_health_matrix, tokenintel_token_context, tokenintel_realtime_prices, tokenintel_price_candles, tokenintel_whale_flows, tokenintel_social_sentiment, tokenintel_capital_rotation, tokenintel_match_impact_history, tokenintel_match_correlation, tokenintel_goal_direction_asymmetry, tokenintel_event_reaction_profile, tokenintel_match_event_replay, tokenintel_match_odds, tokenintel_dex_depth, tokenintel_dex_liquidity · Public sink: tokenintel_register · Destructive: tokenintel_social_sentiment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
